crossRefs.note: But Jesus held his peace. The high priest answered him, “I adjure you by the living God, that you tell us whether you…
I am dark, but lovely, you daughters of Jerusalem, like Kedar’s tents, like Solomon’s curtains.
I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, If you find my beloved, that you tell him that I am faint with love.
His mouth is sweetness; yes, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, daughters of Jerusalem.
I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up nor awaken love…
A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.
I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.
Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.
translations.bsb: O daughters of Jerusalem, I adjure you by the gazelles and does of the field: Do not arouse or awaken love until the time is right.
translations.kjv: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.
translations.asv: I adjure you, O daughters of Jerusalem, By the roes, or by the hinds of the field, That ye stir not up, nor awake my love, Until he please.
